from common import *
import pickle, copy, functools

def yearly(year):
    import numpy as np, pandas as pd, qlib
    from qlib.data.dataset.handler import DataHandlerLP
    from qlib.data.dataset import processor
    from backtest.scripts.evaluate import eval_ic_multi_pool as ev
    from backtest.scripts.maintenance.config_loader import load_config
    from backtest.scripts.train.train_regime_arm import frame_signature
    qlib.init(provider_uri=str(PROVIDER),region='cn',kernels=2)
    processor.datetime_groupby_apply=functools.partial(processor.datetime_groupby_apply,n_jobs=1)
    start=max(f'{year}-01-01','2020-08-03');end=min(f'{year}-12-31','2026-07-31')
    cfg=load_config(str(BASE/'configs/evaluation.yaml'))
    cfg['segments']['test']=[start,end]
    cfg['data']['handler']['learn_processors']=[]
    ds=ev._build_dataset(cfg,'all')
    frame=ds.prepare('test',col_set='feature',data_key=DataHandlerLP.DK_I)
    assert frame.shape[1]==164
    preds=[];doc={'year':year,'segment':[start,end],'features':frame_signature(frame),'predictions':[],'formal_DK_I':True,'learn_chain_omitted_for_inference':True,'ProcessInf_jobs':1,'qlib_kernels':2}
    for label,seed,session in [('old',s,'p50stable_20261106_old_s'+str(s)+'_r1_original') for s in [42,1000,2000,3000,4000]]+[('new_repeat',3000,'p50stable_20261106_new_s3000_r1_original'),('new_reference',3000,'horizonp50_20261105_h20_s3000')]:
        model_path=ROOT/'backtest/result'/session/'run_01/artifacts_root/artifacts/trained_model'
        with model_path.open('rb') as f:model=pickle.load(f)
        p=pd.Series(model.model.predict(frame.values,num_threads=8),index=frame.index,name='score')
        part=TMP/f'inference-{label}-{seed}-{year}.pkl';p.to_pickle(part)
        item={'label':label,'seed':seed,'model':fingerprint(model_path),'part':fingerprint(part)}
        if label in ['new_reference','new_repeat']:
            ref=pd.read_pickle(ROOT/'backtest/result/20261105_horizon_p50/h20/horizonp50_20261105_h20_s3000_pred.pkl').iloc[:,0]
            ref=ref.loc[(ref.index.get_level_values('datetime')>=pd.Timestamp(start))&(ref.index.get_level_values('datetime')<=pd.Timestamp(end))]
            assert p.index.equals(ref.index),'reference inference index differs'
            delta=np.abs(p.to_numpy()-ref.to_numpy())
            item['reference_prediction_exact']=bool(np.array_equal(p.to_numpy(),ref.to_numpy(),equal_nan=True));item['max_abs_reference_delta']=float(np.nanmax(delta))
            item['mean_abs_reference_delta']=float(np.nanmean(delta));item['changed_prediction_rows']=int(np.count_nonzero(delta))
            if label=='new_reference':assert item['reference_prediction_exact'],'same frozen model inference does not reproduce retained predictions'
        doc['predictions'].append(item)
    write(BASE/'docs'/f'{PREFIX}-inference-{year}.json',doc)
    print(f'inference {year}: {len(frame)} rows, retained new-model predictions exact',flush=True)

def consolidate():
    import pandas as pd, numpy as np
    from backtest.scripts.evaluate.ensemble_preds import blend_score_series
    bundle=ROOT/'backtest/result/20261106_p50_stability';bundle.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    write(bundle/'meta.json',{'mode':'research_prediction_bundle','owner_experiment':plan_id(),'note':'Reconstructed old-label H20 five-seed signal, exactness evaluated separately','created_at':time.time()})
    scores=[];components=[]
    prior=read(BASE/'docs/H20-observed-label-effect.json')['seeds']
    for seed in [42,1000,2000,3000,4000]:
        p=pd.concat([pd.read_pickle(TMP/f'inference-old-{seed}-{y}.pkl') for y in range(2020,2027)]).sort_index()
        assert p.index.is_unique and np.isfinite(p.to_numpy()).all()
        if scores:assert p.index.equals(scores[0].index)
        out=bundle/f'old-s{seed}.pkl';p.to_frame('score').to_pickle(out);receipt=fingerprint(out)
        old=next(v for v in prior if v['seed']==seed)['old_prediction']
        components.append({'seed':seed,'session':f'p50stable_20261106_old_s{seed}_r1_original','prediction':receipt,'historical_prediction':old,'historical_pickle_sha_equal':receipt['sha256']==old['sha256']})
        scores.append(p)
    ensemble=blend_score_series(scores);out=bundle/'old-ensemble.pkl';ensemble.to_frame().to_pickle(out)
    doc={'components':components,'ensemble':fingerprint(out),'all_new_reference_annual_predictions_exact':all(read(BASE/'docs'/f'{PREFIX}-inference-{y}.json')['predictions'][-1]['reference_prediction_exact'] for y in range(2020,2027)),'all_old_historical_pickle_sha_equal':all(c['historical_pickle_sha_equal'] for c in components)}
    write(BASE/'docs'/f'{PREFIX}-inference.json',doc);print(json.dumps(doc,indent=2))

def plan_id():return 'training-target/horizon-style-p50-20261105-v1'

if __name__=='__main__':
    register_adapter(__file__)
    if sys.argv[1]=='consolidate':consolidate()
    else:yearly(int(sys.argv[1]))
